title: La Manzana de Cuauhtémoc, MEXI STORIES
comment: manzana-cuauhtemoc (MEXI): huerta de manzanas en Cuauhtémoc, Chihuahua. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.HERMINIA_OCHOA: Mexican woman from Chihuahua, apple grower, 68 years old, small and thin, wrinkled light-brown skin, white hair in a low bun, a maroon knitted wool cardigan over a dark floral blouse, a long dark-brown skirt, flat black shoes, her hands empty.
chars.JOEL_OCHOA: Mexican man from Chihuahua, 29 years old, tall and thin, light brown skin, short black hair, a short black beard, a red-and-black plaid flannel shirt under a tan canvas work jacket, jeans, work boots, his hands empty.
chars.KEVIN_LOERA: Mexican man, 34 years old, light skin, slicked-back black hair, a thin black mustache, a shiny black puffer jacket open over a burgundy button-up shirt, a silver watch, dark jeans, pointed black boots, his hands empty.
chars.ANSELMO_QUINONES: Mexican man from Chihuahua, 65 years old, tall and broad, light skin, grey hair, a grey goatee, a black felt cowboy hat, a long dark-brown sheepskin coat, a big silver belt buckle, dark trousers, black boots, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_HUERTACUAUH: Apple orchard packing yard in Cuauhtémoc, Chihuahua, in the late autumn afternoon: rows of apple trees full of red apples, stacked wooden apple crates, a small weathered wooden packing shed, a dirt road along the orchard, dry golden grass, a pale cold sky, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
